column1: # All instances of module names found more than once in the corpus (see README.md).
# diff: vs the winner: same = identical text, ws = differs only in comments/whitespace,
#       text = differs only inside strings (DESCRIPTION etc.), syntax = differs outside strings.
# Names that only occur in history sources (older vendor releases) have no winner: diff is
# relative to the newest release. type = source type; official = 1: the copy of the vendor's
# official distribution of a module it owns (index.py: VENDORS).
# reason (winner row only): why it won: override (index.py: OVERRIDES), official (official copy
# of a vendor-owned module), newer-aggregator (a non-official copy with a strictly newer
# LAST-UPDATED than every official copy), standards / rank (source rank, LAST-UPDATED, path).
